description: This Java class implements a service for reading client attendance data for meetings from a database in the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to query attendance records by meeting ID, mapping rows from SQL query results into data transfer objects.

classes.name: ClientAttendanceReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface to read client attendance data from the database.

classes.name: ClientAttendanceDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class that maps SQL result set rows to ClientAttendanceData objects.

methods.name: retrieveClientAttendanceByMeetingId
methods.description: Fetches a collection of client attendance data for a specific meeting ID from the database.
